title: Taco Feast Under Stained Glass
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a plate of dripping tacos on an ornate turquoise table with hot sauce, lime wedges, and a bottle of Tapatio. Above floats a massive colorful stained glass rose window, while a green-skinned woman with elaborate multicolored hair emerges from clouds holding a paper, surrounded by red lanterns and lush foliage.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene with a large ornate circular stained glass window glowing at the top of the composition. Below it, a turquoise table holds a plate of messy tacos with dripping red sauce, lime wedges, and a bottle of Tapatio hot sauce. A green-skinned woman with wild, flowing multicolored hair emerges from clouds on the left. Red paper lanterns and lush green plants surround the scene. Dramatic lighting with rays shining from the window, intricate details, vibrant colors.
